      public void checkForEndOfRoundPick(TurnManager turnManager) throws IllegalPhaseActionException
      This method is used to check if any player has the specific building card that grants an extra card pick from the top at the EndOfRound Phase.

    • pickCardFromTop

      public void pickCardFromTop(TurnManager turnManager, Player player, CharacterCard card, Board board) throws IllegalPhaseActionException
      This method is used to allow the player to pick a CharacterCard from the top row during the end-of-round phase. After picking, the player's top draw count is reset, the active player index is reset, and the standard end-of-round routine resumes.
      Overrides:
      pickCardFromTop in class Phase
      Parameters:
      turnManager - The turn manager controlling the flow of the game.
      player - The player performing the action.
      card - The CharacterCard being picked.
      board - The game board.
      Throws:
      IllegalPhaseActionException - If the phase hasn't started or the player has no top draws left.

    • pickCardFromTop

      public void pickCardFromTop(TurnManager turnManager, Player player, BuildingCard card, Board board) throws IllegalPhaseActionException, IllegalArgumentException, IllegalGameActionException
      This method is used to allow the player to pick a BuildingCard from the top row during the end-of-round phase. After picking, the player's top draw count is reset, the active player index is reset, and the standard end-of-round routine resumes.
      Overrides:
      pickCardFromTop in class Phase
      Parameters:

      player - The player performing the action.

      board - The game board.
      Throws:

      IllegalGameActionException - If the action violates general game rules.

    • checkForRightToSkip

      public boolean checkForRightToSkip(Player player, Board board) throws IllegalPhaseActionException
      This method checks if a player has the right to skip picking a card from the top row. During this phase, a player with remaining draws can only skip if there are no CharacterCards available in the top row.
      Overrides:
      checkForRightToSkip in class Phase
      Parameters:
      player - The player requesting to skip.
      board - The game board containing the top row cards.
      Returns:
      true if the player is allowed to skip, false otherwise.
      Throws:
      IllegalPhaseActionException - If this check cannot be performed in the current context.
